summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, covering the monthly report of a foreign private issuer. The filing contains no material non-routine event—it appears to be a mechanical filing of periodic report for the month of April 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine current report for a foreign issuer. No deal terms are present.
